subject: Payments onboarding: banking credentials, PO routing & remittance email
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Trevor Small <trevor@mapleanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff - bank creds, PO routing & remit address

Hi Trevor —

Welcome! I'm Irene on Redwood's vendor onboarding team. We're starting the procurement onboarding for Maple Analytics. To get you set up in our ERP and ensure timely payment, can you please confirm the items below? If it's easier, you can reply to this thread with attachments.

Checklist (needed to create vendor record and enable payment flow):
- Completed vendor onboarding template (attached) with legal name and remit-to name
- W-9 or local tax equivalent (if applicable)
- Bank routing letter or voided check for ACH; bank letter for wires
- Preferred payment method: ACH (domestic), Wire (domestic/intl), or other
- Remittance email address (where invoices should be sent) and any required invoice header fields (PO on invoice? invoice-to address)
- Preferred payment terms (Net30, Net45, etc.) and billing contact
- Any PO routing instructions (e.g., PO number required in subject or a specific billing code)

Notes about our flow: Redwood issues a PO for purchases over $2,500. Invoices received via email to the remittance address will be routed into our AP queue; please put the PO number on the invoice to speed processing. If you have a preferred invoice portal, include the link and we can evaluate.

I've attached the vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx to capture the answers. Once we have the bank documentation and W-9 we can request vendor creation and issue the first PO.

Next steps for you (ideally within 3 business days):
1) Complete the attached template and attach bank letter/W-9
2) Confirm remit email and whether invoices will reference a PO
3) Confirm payment method and bank details (we can accept a bank letter via DocuSign)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
(415) 555-0146

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx

From: Trevor Small <trevor@mapleanalytics.com>

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the overview. I'm Trevor (Finance lead at Maple). Attaching our completed vendor form plus a signed bank letter and our W-9.

Quick answers inline:
- Payment method: ACH (USD) preferred; we can accept wire for international transfers if needed.
- Bank doc: attached bank_letter_signed.pdf — routing and account masked in email for security; happy to provide full details over DocuSign or secure portal.
- Remittance email: invoices@mapleanalytics.com (please cc billing@mapleanalytics.com)
- PO on invoice: yes — please include the PO number on the invoice. If the PO is not present, our AP team may delay processing.
- Payment terms: Net30.
- Billing contact: Jen Kline (j.kline@mapleanalytics.com)
- Invoice submission method: email to invoices@mapleanalytics.com; we do not use a portal today.

We'd like to confirm whether Redwood needs a copy of the bank letter notarized or if DocuSign attestation is sufficient. I'm happy to complete the DocuSign if that's preferred.

Thanks — attaching: W-9_MapleAnalytics.pdf, bank_letter_signed.pdf, completed_vendor_onboarding.pdf

Best,
Trevor Small
Finance Lead | Maple Analytics Inc.
trevor@mapleanalytics.com
+1 (646) 555-0109

- For PO routing: please ask your billing team to include "PO-RED-873" in the invoice header when we issue the PO; that will map the invoice to the correct cost center automatically.
- Noted net30 — Marcus, can you confirm approval for Net30 with Maple? Any reason to request Net45 due to vendor risk?

Irene — I'll queue the vendor record after Marcus gives the OK and Trevor's bank letter is accepted.

- Pay-to legal name: Maple Analytics Inc.
- Tax ID: (confirmed via attached W-9)
